requirement_summary: Knowledge Fork / Merge Governance: Tenant/Industry/Global knowledge가 fork된 뒤 merge될 수 있으므로 ancestor epoch, divergent changes, conflicts, chosen resolution, merge receipt를 보존한다. silent overwrite 금지.
subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.java (knowledgeForkMergeGovernanceCheck), assurance.learning.knowledge-fork-merge-governance.check v2 operation; contracts/knowledge-fork-merge-governance-check.v1.schema.json (NEW, built this pass)
observed_source: SemanticAssuranceV2DispatcherBridgeTest (real dispatch through the full RBAC/workflow chain)
coverage_notes: unresolved_conflicts is computed for real by cross-referencing detected_conflicts against conflict_resolutions by conflict_id -- a matching-between-two-arrays check JSON Schema cannot express. Any detected conflict with no resolution entry (or a resolution entry with a blank resolution_basis) forces MERGE_BLOCKED, naming every unresolved conflict individually -- directly closing 'silent overwrite 금지' (a conflict cannot be silently overwritten by one side simply winning without an explicit, recorded resolution). ancestor_epoch_id and merge_receipt_id are always required and echoed, satisfying the requirement's preservation obligation for those fields regardless of decision.
open_gap: This operation validates that every detected conflict HAS a resolution; it does not itself independently detect conflicts from raw divergent-change data (conflict detection itself is trusted from the caller). Independent conflict detection from raw source/target branch diffs is a real, disclosed follow-on.
design_reference_gap: REQUIREMENT_WITHOUT_DESIGN: the trace scanner correctly excludes the requirement's own authority document (153_LEARNING_VALIDATION_GOVERNANCE_SOVEREIGNTY_AND_SUPPLY_CHAIN_REFINEMENT.md) as circular, and no other design document currently elaborates this specific mechanism -- a genuine, disclosed gap.
